WITH months AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t0.month_num AS month_num, t0.month_label AS month_label
  FROM calendar_days t0
  WHERE t0.year_num = 2025
),
converted_payouts AS (
  SELECT
    t0.id AS payout_id,
    t2.year_num AS year_num,
    t2.month_num AS month_num,
    t0.gross_amount / t1.rate AS gross_eur,
    t0.fee_amount / t1.rate AS fee_eur,
    t0.net_amount / t1.rate AS net_eur
  FROM payouts t0
  JOIN exchange_rates t1
    ON t1.base_code = 'EUR'
   AND t1.quote_code = t0.currency_code
   AND t1.as_of = CAST(t0.paid_at AS date)
  JOIN calendar_days t2
    ON t2.calendar_date = CAST(t0.paid_at AS date)
  WHERE t0.paid_at IS NOT NULL
    AND t0.status IN ('paid', 'completed')
),
current_year AS (
  SELECT
    t0.month_num AS month_num,
    COUNT(*) AS payout_count,
    SUM(t0.gross_eur) AS gross_eur_total,
    SUM(t0.fee_eur) AS fee_eur_total,
    SUM(t0.net_eur) AS net_eur_total
  FROM converted_payouts t0
  WHERE t0.year_num = 2025
  GROUP BY t0.month_num
),
prior_year AS (
  SELECT
    t0.month_num AS month_num,
    SUM(t0.fee_eur) AS fee_eur_total_prior
  FROM converted_payouts t0
  WHERE t0.year_num = 2024
  GROUP BY t0.month_num
)
SELECT
  t0.month_label AS month,
  COALESCE(t1.payout_count, 0) AS payout_count,
  ROUND(COALESCE(t1.gross_eur_total, 0), 2) AS gross_volume_eur,
  ROUND(COALESCE(t1.fee_eur_total, 0), 2) AS fee_revenue_eur,
  ROUND(COALESCE(t1.net_eur_total, 0), 2) AS net_paid_out_eur,
  ROUND(COALESCE(t1.fee_eur_total, 0) / NULLIF(t1.gross_eur_total, 0) * 100, 1) AS fee_rate_pct,
  ROUND(COALESCE(t2.fee_eur_total_prior, 0), 2) AS fee_revenue_prior_year_eur
FROM months t0
LEFT JOIN current_year t1 ON t1.month_num = t0.month_num
LEFT JOIN prior_year t2 ON t2.month_num = t0.month_num
ORDER BY t0.month_num
note: The payouts.status codes aren't enumerated in the catalog, so I filtered status IN ('paid','completed') as the settled/completed states; please flag if the warehouse uses different literal status values so we can correct. All 12 months of 2025 are shown (zero-filled where no settled payouts exist), with 2024 fee revenue for the same month as the comparison column.
